acceptance_checks.current_desktop_platform: Electron desktop application in packages/desktop, targeting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
runtime_boundaries_identified: Main process, preload, and sandboxed renderer boundary
Renderer-to-main IPC registry and typed preload bridge
Electron shell and Node access through contextBridge APIs
Main filesystem/watcher versus renderer file-workflow boundary
Renderer access to @muyajs/core through its public package boundary

factual_errors.claim: focusMode is currently a no-op and its render path should be deferred.
factual_errors.explanation: The current implementation applies and toggles the focus-mode class, CSS dims inactive blocks, and tests cover it. The answer relied on stale backlog text for an engine recommendation.

factual_errors.claim: Legacy muyajs cleanup is only dead dependency/alias/type wiring and has very low risk.
factual_errors.explanation: Runtime imports are absent, but active workflow, tooling, and configuration references make the cleanup scope and risk broader than stated.

factual_errors.claim: Path identity has three same-name implementations.
factual_errors.repository_evidence: packages/desktop/src/common/filesystem/paths.ts:135-166 and packages/desktop/src/preload/index.ts:111-156; renderer receives the preload implementation through global.d.ts.
factual_errors.explanation: There are two implementations with different fallbacks, not three independent same-name implementations. The underlying semantic-drift concern remains valid.

factual_errors.repository_evidence: packages/desktop/src/main/utils/internalIpc.ts:8-13 calls ipcMain.on; emitters are in editor.ts, setting.ts, and app/index.ts.
factual_errors.explanation: The shared internal ipcMain namespace is real, but the answer attributes the emitter to the wrong file.

factual_errors.claim: The IPC registry has an mt:: prefix invariant and typecheck rejects every unregistered channel.
factual_errors.repository_evidence: packages/desktop/src/shared/types/ipc.ts:40-289 contains non-mt internal keys; CLAUDE.md:264 says most channels use mt::; main code also calls raw ipcMain handlers and sends.
factual_errors.explanation: The typed preload bridge constrains its own call sites, but the registry does not enforce all main-process registrations or internal channels.

factual_errors.claim: Desktop only imports @muyajs/core from its root public entry and does not touch internal paths.
factual_errors.explanation: Renderer production imports mostly use the root entry, but the desktop test surface has an internal subpath import.

factual_errors.claim: IFileState is the unique cross-process document contract.
factual_errors.repository_evidence: packages/desktop/src/shared/types/files.ts:62-105 defines IFileState, while ipc.ts uses MarkdownDocument, UnsavedFile, FileChangeDetail, and unknown payloads; FileNotification.action is a function.
factual_errors.explanation: IFileState is documented as canonical shared state, but it is not the sole serialized IPC shape.

factual_errors.claim: webSecurity:false is specifically an accepted relaxation for file:// relative-path images.
factual_errors.repository_evidence: packages/desktop/src/main/config.ts:11-20,34-41 sets webSecurity:false; base.ts uses file:// and image-relative-path tests exist, but no implementation comment, ADR, or history establishes that causal rationale.
factual_errors.explanation: The setting and related file:// behavior are evidenced, but the stated rationale is presented more confidently than the repository supports.

factual_errors.claim: The grep found only three legacy code comments.
factual_errors.repository_evidence: Current legacy comment references include packages/desktop/src/renderer/src/codeMirror/markdownMathMode.ts:19, util/dompurify.ts:31, components/sideBar/icon.vue:10, and multiple desktop test files.
factual_errors.explanation: The runtime-import conclusion is supported, but the reported count and scope of remaining references are inaccurate.

documentation_drift.claim: CLAUDE.md:241-245 documents contextIsolation:false and nodeIntegration:true, while the current configuration and e2e security test establish the opposite; the answer explicitly reports and resolves this conflict.
The answer repeats the stale focusMode no-op statement and does not resolve the conflict with the implemented and tested focus-mode behavior.

CLAUDE.md contains stale legacy-engine architecture text conflicting with the current @muyajs/core runtime; the answer’s direct source check resolves the runtime decision, although it does not enumerate all stale passages.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: packages/desktop/src production imports @muyajs/core; legacy references remain in declarations, aliases, tests, and tooling.

rationale: The review is broad, option-rich, and gives concrete reversible migration gates, with strong identification of real window, IPC, filesystem, and engine-boundary friction. It loses evidence and recommendation credit because it treats stale focus-mode documentation as current, overstates several boundaries, and does not substantiate its history/test verification. Accuracy fails because one material error and one unresolved decision-relevant documentation conflict remain.
